personal_info.summary: Passionate Software Developer with experience in structuring and developing Software Systems. My goal is to create innovative and scalable technological solutions that drive business growth. I stand out for designing attractive and functional user interfaces, as well as developing dynamic applications, managing from Frontend to Backend. Organized, methodical, responsible and proactive, I look for new challenges to improve my technical skills and deliver high quality results.
